verdict.rationale: Qdrant is described as a service to store, search, and manage points (qdrant-gh-5). A production user reports tens of millions of items with lots of daily inserts and deletions that behave predictably (qdrant-comm-1), though another user wishes updating points were easier (qdrant-comm-3). The pack has no documentation of upsert/delete APIs, indexing latency, or freshness and consistency guarantees, so only the core continuous-mutation workflow is evidenced. Missing for 10: first-party docs on upsert/delete operations, documented write-to-search visibility latency, documented consistency/ordering semantics (e.g. wait/write-consistency options), independent freshness benchmarks.
